items.action: Notice of supplemental funding to Johns Hopkins University (JHU), a current HRSA awardee for the Autism Longitudinal Data Project.
items.summary: HRSA administers this grant using funding made available by the Health and Human Services Assistant Secretary for Planning and Evaluation (ASPE) from the Patient Centered Outcomes Research Trust Fund (PCORTF) and awarded for this purpose to JHU. ASPE/PCORTF supports this multi-agency data linkage project to build further data capacity. Supplemental funding was previously awarded in fiscal year (FY) 2024 and FY25 to initiate the data linkage and user testing process. This award is a continuation of this work and the final year for this ASPE/ PCORTF award. If JHU does not receive this award, it will not have the funds needed to execute the final phase of the data linkage project.

items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is classifying the flushing and storage solution for vascular autografts at room temperature into class II (special controls). The special controls that apply to the device type are identified in this order and will be part of the codified language for classification of the flushing and storage solution for vascular autografts at room temperature. We are taking this action because we have determined that classifying the device into class II will provide a reasonable assurance of the safety and effectiveness of the device. We believe this action will also enhance patients' access to beneficial innovative devices, in part by reducing regulatory burdens.
items.title: Medical Devices; Gastroenterology-Urology Devices; Classification of the Flushing and Storage Solution for Vascular Autografts at Room Temperature
